title: Customizing the Zscaler Client Connector Theme

blocks.text: You can customize the Zscaler Client Connector app to display your company’s logo and company name instead of the Zscaler logo on the app header and in pop-up notifications.
This feature is available only for Zscaler Client Connector version 4.9 and later for Windows. Contact Zscaler Support to enable this feature.

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Infrastructure > Client Connector > Client Connector Theme.
On the Text Settings tab, enter the name of your organization.

This name is appended to the notification logo on pop-up notifications. If you don’t enter an organization name, notifications display the default Zscaler branding, even if you upload a notification logo.

Company Logo: Click Upload and browse to or drag and drop the logo file to use in the top left of the Zscaler app header. The logo must be a .PNG file that does not exceed 50KB. Zscaler recommends using light or white text on a transparent background.

Notification Logo: Click Upload and browse to or drag and drop the logo file to use in the top left of pop-up notifications. The logo must be a .PNG file that does not exceed 50KB. Zscaler recommends using a transparent background.
You can upload a logo in one or both fields.

blocks.text: After you customize a theme, you can select Enable Custom Theme on the app profile to display your logos and company name in the app and pop-up notifications for users with that app profile.
The company logo displays in the app header.
The notification logo and the organization name display on the pop-up notification.
The custom theme doesn’t display for end user notifications (EUNs) from Internet & SaaS. You can customize those notifications in the Zscaler Admin Console.
